```yaml
name: Build macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos-dmg:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    env:
      # Ensure universal binaries are built
      ARCHS: "x86_64 arm64"
      # Set deployment target to the oldest supported macOS version
      MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: "10.15"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Install Xcode command line tools
        run: |
          if ! xcode-select -p > /dev/null; then
            echo "Installing Xcode command line tools..."
            xcode-select --install || true
          fi
          # Ensure the latest Xcode is selected
          sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_15.0.app/Contents/Developer

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)" || true
          brew update
          brew install --no-quarantine libarchive

      - name: Cache Homebrew packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: /usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Taps
          key: brew-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Brewfile') }}
          restore-keys: |
            brew-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Build universal binaries
        run: |
          make clean
          make build-universal

      - name: Create DMG
        run: |
          make dmg
          echo "DMG created at $(pwd)/dist/*.dmg"

      - name: Upload DMG artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sshpilot-macos-dmg
          path: dist/*.dmg
          retention-days: 7
```
